title: The Builders of the Lofty Pillars
intro: You stand before the ruins of a majestic ancient city, its lofty pillars now fallen. The wind howls through the empty streets, carrying the memory of a mighty people who once ruled these lands. Who were they?
clues: We were a people of immense strength and skill, known for our great buildings and advanced civilization.
We lived in a land of sand dunes and rocky hills, and we believed no one could overpower us.
A messenger came to us from among our own kin, calling us to worship Allah alone, but we rejected and ridiculed him.
We boasted, 'Who is stronger than us?' and we continued in our arrogance and idol worship.
Allah sent upon us a furious wind that blew for seven nights and eight days, laying waste to everything.
We were the people of 'Ad, the builders of Iram, and our fate became a warning for all who came after.

trial.label: What was the punishment sent upon them?

location.label: What is the name of their legendary city?

outcome.label: What was their ultimate fate?
options: They were destroyed and their remains became a lesson
They were drowned in the sea
They were buried under a landslide
outcome.answer: They were destroyed and their remains became a lesson

arabic: تُدَمِّرُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍۭ بِأَمْرِ رَبِّهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ لَا يُرَىٰٓ إِلَّا مَسَـٰكِنُهُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verse: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people. (46:25)
